status: TERMINAL FOR THE ESTIMAND ROUTE, AWAITING OPERATOR
kind: registered stop condition reached before any null-only or real measurement

which_stop_condition.clause: any C1 OD-011 rev-2 case fails, including the flatten-only pipeline case
which_stop_condition.consequence_registered_in_advance: C1 is out, the surviving candidate count falls to zero, and the phase stops and reports; C1 is not repaired and no candidate is added
which_stop_condition.MDE_was_never_computed: correctly so; the power of an eliminated estimand is not a meaningful quantity

no_op.observed_per_layer: approximately -0.50 at EVERY layer, tightly and consistently

flatten_only.note: this is the cell the OD-022 sweep structurally could not see

attenuated_transfer.note: a 50 percent transfer scored HIGHER than a 100 percent transfer, which is incoherent for an estimator that should be monotone in the amount transferred

the_diagnosis_and_why_it_is_not_a_bug.statement: C1's registered form is effect = raw(patched) minus the mean over replicates of raw(destructive patch). It therefore subtracts a destruction term from EVERY patch, including patches that were never destroyed.
the_diagnosis_and_why_it_is_not_a_bug.the_no_op_case_in_arithmetic: for a no-op, raw(patched) equals the baseline, so the effect reduces to baseline minus the null mean, which is neither zero nor close to it
the_diagnosis_and_why_it_is_not_a_bug.why_not: the implementation computes exactly the registered expression; the shortlist defined C1 as a subtraction of a measured destruction term, and that is what it does. Changing it so a no-op returns zero would be REPAIRING THE CANDIDATE, which the pre-registration forbids

the_magnitude_that_settles_it.reading: the estimator's own subtraction term is more than THIRTEEN TIMES the largest genuine effect it would have to detect; it is dominated by the quantity it subtracts

why_the_OD_022_sweep_did_not_catch_this.the_honesty_note_that_predicted_it: C1's flatten column in the sweep was exactly 0.000000 because the minuend and the subtrahend were the same deterministic function, so the cancellation was BY IDENTITY. That was recorded as a limitation of the sweep, not a strength of C1, before this demonstration was written
why_the_OD_022_sweep_did_not_catch_this.the_deeper_gap_now_visible: the sweep evaluates candidates ONLY ON DESTRUCTIVE PATCHES. It never evaluates a no-op, because a no-op is not a destruction construction. C1's worst failure is therefore in a cell the sweep could not reach even in principle

the_governance_observation.statement: OD-022 and OD-011 revision 2 are COMPLEMENTARY and neither is sufficient alone
the_governance_observation.OD-011_rev_2_tests: behaviour under NON-destruction, including the no-op and a genuine transfer
the_governance_observation.evidence: C1 passed OD-022 and failed OD-011 rev 2 in four cases out of five
the_governance_observation.recorded_as: an observation about the two gates; it proposes no new rule, because proposing one now would be acting on an unfavourable result

what_this_does_and_does_not_mean.it_does_mean: the closed four-candidate shortlist is exhausted: three eliminated by the OD-022 sweep and the fourth by the OD-011 rev-2 pipeline demonstration. No estimand registered in this study can currently measure the constructed object
it_does_not_mean: it does not mean no valid estimand exists; it means none of the four declared ones works and the executing party may not choose a fifth
it does not weaken the object, which established on its own registered criteria and remains established
it says nothing about real items, about J-space, about the J-lens, about the paper or about T
it is NOT an UNDERPOWERED determination; power was never computed, because an eliminated estimand's power is not a meaningful quantity

what_survives_intact.the_harness: bit-exact no-ops re-proven in both precisions on this object
what_survives_intact.the_measurement_pre_registration: its MDE pass-line, its three outcome wordings and its decision rule stand unused and unmodified, available to any successor

decisions_reserved_for_the_operator: whether a fifth candidate estimand may be declared, which the executing party may not do
whether requiring a no-op to return exactly zero is the right requirement for a null-SUBTRACTING estimand at all, since subtraction-based estimands are structurally incapable of satisfying it
whether the correct response is a different CLASS of estimand, one that does not subtract
whether to stop the J-lens route here
claim_ceiling: A blocker record. It licenses no claim of any kind, and it is not a finding.
